scenes.title: Title card
scenes.voiceover: YouTube Downloader. Links in, music files out.

scenes.title: The problem
scenes.voiceover: Found a live performance you want to keep as a music file?

scenes.title: Paste the link and load it
scenes.voiceover: Paste the YouTube link and click Load. The app reads the title, artist, and length.

scenes.title: Choose MP3 at 128 kbps
scenes.voiceover: Pick Audio MP3 and a quality. One twenty-eight kilobits per second keeps files small.

scenes.title: Download
scenes.voiceover: Click Download. The app downloads, converts, and tags the file in seconds.

scenes.title: The tagged MP3
scenes.voiceover: Here it is. Named, tagged with title and artist, and with the cover art.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.voiceover: No sign-in needed. Get it from the link below.
